Washington, DC, February 22, 2026 – A new ABC News/Washington Post/Ipsos poll finds more Americans disapprove (64%) than approve (34%) of President Donald Trump’s handling of tariffs on imported goods. Trump’s approval rating on tariffs – as well as on his handling of inflation – lag behind his overall approval rating. Despite these negative ratings, Americans are split on who they trust to better handle reducing the cost of living: equal shares trust Trump (32%) and Democrats in Congress [...] The poll was conducted prior to the February 20 U.S. Supreme Court ruling that struck down President Trump's tariffs on imported goods.
